name: Svitlanka
bio:
Svitlanka is a tattoo artist whose elegant work in minimalist and lettering styles breathes life into cherished memories and ideas on skin. Her portfolio showcases beautifully refined graphics, exquisite depictions of flowers, plants, and animals that capture the essence of her clients' vision with an impressive grace and finesse. With a particular dedication to cleanliness, Svitlanka ensures that each tattoo session is not only a creative journey but also a hygienic one, providing a safe and reassuring experience for all who seek her artistry.
